name: nested-vaul-drawer
blurb: Multiple drawers stack and animate up from the bottom on mobile.
description: Gesture-driven drawer system from Vaul that supports unlimited nesting. Each drawer slides up from the bottom with physics-based animation, and nested drawers layer on top. Handles swipe-to-close naturally.
use_when: You need deep navigation flows on mobile without leaving the viewport.
avoid_when: Desktop-only experiences — drawer is optimized for mobile gesture interaction.
a11y: Built on Radix Dialog primitives with full keyboard support. Escape closes the top drawer. Focus wrapping and ARIA attributes from Radix.
